**How the path fits together**

This learning path is designed to help learners become confident public speakers and presenters. The first course, Dynamic Public Speaking Specialization, provides a solid foundation in public speaking and presentation skills. The next course, Public Speaking, builds on this foundation by providing a more in-depth exploration of public speaking, including how to apply the basic elements of the speech communication process, and how to control public speaking anxiety. The subsequent courses, Introduction to Public Speaking, The Language of Leaders: Learn to Speak with Confidence, Speak English Professionally: In Person, Online & On the Phone, Professional Business Presentations, Communicating with the Public, Applied Storytelling, and Training and Practicing in English Public Speaking, provide advanced training in public speaking, presentation skills, and storytelling. The final course, The Craft of Storytelling, provides advanced training in storytelling, including how to find good stories, target what audiences want in a story, and build the dramatic arc. Throughout the path, learners will develop the skills to communicate effectively with the public, design and deliver clear and impactful speeches, and speak confidently and effectively in English.

learning_path:
**Learning Path for Sustainability, Environmental Policy, and Corporate Responsibility**

| Period | Course ID | Course Title | Platform | Why this course |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | EDX3225 | Business Sustainability Management | edx | Foundational knowledge of sustainability concepts and business practices |
| 2 | EDX3340 | Corporate Sustainability Management: Risk, Profit, and Purpose | edx | Builds on foundational knowledge, introducing corporate sustainability management and risk analysis |
| 3 | EDX3254 | Oxford Leading Sustainable Corporations Programme | edx | Develops systems thinking and leadership skills for sustainable corporations |
| 4 | EDX2078 | Introduction to Corporate Sustainability, Social Innovation and Ethics | edx | Emphasizes the importance of ethics and social innovation in corporate sustainability |
| 5 | EDX1173 | Environmental Gamechanger – Lead the Way to Sustainable Development | edx | Focuses on practical skills for achieving sustainable development |
| 6 | EDX3299 | Business Sustainability Strategy: Technology and Management | edx | Develops strategic thinking and technology management skills for sustainable business |
| 7 | EDX2424 | Discovering Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) | edx | Introduces CSR concepts and practices, building on previous courses |
| 8 | EDX3418 | Leading Sustainability: High Impact Leadership | edx | Develops leadership skills for high-impact sustainability initiatives |
| 9 | EDX3239 | Sustainable Finance | edx | Focuses on sustainable finance and investment strategies |
| 10 | EDX3227 | Climate Change and Business: Sustainability, Risk and the Push for Net Zero | edx | Develops skills for climate change mitigation and adaptation in business |

**Why this learning path?**

This learning path starts with foundational knowledge of sustainability concepts and business practices (EDX3225). It then builds on this knowledge with corporate sustainability management and risk analysis (EDX3340), and develops systems thinking and leadership skills for sustainable corporations (EDX3254). The path emphasizes the importance of ethics and social innovation in corporate sustainability (EDX2078) and focuses on practical skills for achieving sustainable development (EDX1173). It also develops strategic thinking and technology management skills for sustainable business (EDX3299) and introduces CSR concepts and practices (EDX2424). Finally, it develops leadership skills for high-impact sustainability initiatives (EDX3418) and focuses on sustainable finance and investment strategies (EDX3239). The path concludes with skills for climate change mitigation and adaptation in business (EDX3227).

This learning path covers the full duration requested, with at least one course per period, and provides a comprehensive understanding of sustainability, environmental policy, and corporate responsibility.

The information should be at a beginner level and should cover a duration of 1-3 months. I would like to learn the basics of sustainability, environmental policy, and corporate responsibility.
